question.en: Discuss the role of the World Bank Group in promoting sustainable development in developing economies like India.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the World Bank Group in promoting sustainable development in developing economies like India.

modelAnswer.en: The WBG supports India through infrastructure financing (IBRD), social sector development (IDA), and private sector capacity building (IFC). It helps in policy reforms, technical assistance, and climate resilience projects.
